title: The 2 Best Travel Adapters for Europe
h1: The 2 Best Travel Adapters for Europe
metaDescription: Our 2 picks for travel adapters for europe, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at travel adapters for europe using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: OREI World Travel Plug Adapter
products.blurb: Key specs: Slide-out plug attachments including Type C/E/F and Type G, 2 USB-A ports plus 1 universal AC outlet, Safety shutters and fuse protection.
strengths: Small enough to keep in a daypack pocket for daily sightseeing
Safety shutters block accidental contact with live pins
limitations: Only one AC outlet limits simultaneous device charging
USB ports top out at 2A, slower than PD-equipped alternatives
features: Slide-out plug attachments including Type C/E/F and Type G
2 USB-A ports plus 1 universal AC outlet

products.name: OREI World Travel Plug Adapter M8 Max
products.blurb: Key specs: Interchangeable plug heads for Europe and the UK, 2 USA outlets, 3 USB-A ports, 1 USB-C PD 18W port, Grounded 3-prong design.
strengths: Six total charging points from a single European hotel outlet
18W USB-C PD charges a phone noticeably faster than USB-A-only kits
Grounded design adds safety margin for laptop chargers
limitations: Larger and heavier than a simple plug-only adapter
18W PD is not enough to fast-charge most laptops
features: Interchangeable plug heads for Europe and the UK
2 USA outlets, 3 USB-A ports, 1 USB-C PD 18W port
